atomic-policy.semantics: Coherent cloned snapshot disclosure and durable serialization retained. range-stability.subject: fix(computer): reject changed ranged-read snapshots
range-stability.semantics: Each ranged read compares file identity, mode, size, mtime, ctime and link count before publishing; mutation refuses. This is per-window stability, not a persistent cross-page snapshot.

root-refusal.subject: test(computer): preserve native filesystem root refusal
root-refusal.semantics: Pure authority may represent /; native selected-root and approved-ancestor traversal requires named components and refuses / before filesystem IO.

typed-read.semantics: Typed canonical DTO parsing and independent Computer contract retained; ReadMethodForOperation selects exactly one immutable ordinary execution lease in trusted boot composition, checks expected binding and maps to NewForExecution. Dependency pins and narrowly allowlisted pure x/text imports retained. Disposable proof is not installed capability acceptance.

corrected-wire.subject: fix(core): align read proof with corrected wire contracts
corrected-wire.semantics: Equivalent bounded JSON integer spellings decode consistently in generated ComputerReadRange (4..262144); decimal strings preserve offsets beyond JS precision. Closable owned proof pipes and corrected wire assertions retained.

unicode.subject: fix(core): reject surrogate replacement at the wire boundary

unicode-race-tests.subject: test(core): cover Unicode path and native race refusals
unicode-race-tests.semantics: Unicode path spelling, full/ranged reads, byte bounds, authority/native refusal codes, stale/missing backend, malformed frames and lost-reply unknown/no-replay assertions retained. Wire-injected race refusal is explicitly synthetic; real filesystem race evidence belongs to native filesystem tests.

operation-id.subject: fix(core): derive operation identity from canonical method kinds
operation-id.semantics: RequiresOperationID comes from immutable canonical read/effect method metadata; read forbids and effect requires operation identity before backend/owner availability can affect admission.

registry.subject: fix(core): keep method registry limited to admission kinds
registry.semantics: Generated immutable registry publishes known methods and read/effect admission kinds only; it does not claim module-owner authority or infer binding from callers.

source-format.subject: build(core): version the canonical wire source format
source-format.semantics: farol-wire/2 remains canonical generator/source format, independent from transport wire 1.0. Unsupported generator/metadata are refused; no wire version conflation.

owner-output.subject: fix(core): contain malformed owner output and enforce request identity
owner-output.semantics: Malformed owner output becomes correlated unknown owner_output_invalid without data disclosure, replay or shared-pipe destruction. Exact request/operation/context checks and operation-ID admission before owner availability retained.

borrowed-limits.subject: fix(core): detach borrowed clients and reject unsupported wire limits
borrowed-limits.semantics: Borrowed Client terminal detaches its own streams/listeners and preserves foreign listeners; generator fixes 1MiB/depth32/4096 limits and refuses unsupported alternatives. Later reciprocal polls use a reserved namespace with exact context, monotonic sequence and unchanged nonce, no operation ID, separate from ordinary request cap; catalogue bound grows from 64 to 128.
